system.description:
Veterans of the Wall facing the Red Waste — disciplined, grim, no pageantry.

  • Wall-Forged Dread: Demoralise penalty increases to -6 to Charisma checks, and affected enemies have Disadvantage on all their attack rolls (instead of only their first each round).
  • Siege Discipline: Advantage on checks involving fortification, siege assessment, or coordinating soldiers during a defensive action.
